headline: Approved a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Heard Street and a car wash sign at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard.
summary: Members approved a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Heard Street and an illuminated sign for a car wash at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, both with conditions. They also approved a storage addition at 19 Lawton Street. Neighbors spoke against the car wash, citing flooding and traffic.
decisions: Approved a variance for a storage addition at 19 Lawton Street, 6-0 on roll call.
Approved a special permit for an illuminated sign and a variance for a larger freestanding sign at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, with conditions, 6-0 on roll call.
Approved variances for a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Heard Street, with conditions, on roll call.
discussion: Car wash sign: Neighbors spoke against the car wash, citing flooding, groundwater, traffic, and odors. Members said the board decides only the sign and its lighting, while other boards decide the car wash itself.
Floodplain rules: A speaker said the site is in a regulatory floodway, where the city code bars fill. The applicant said the Conservation Commission will review flood impact later.

Parking at 41 Heard Street: Members asked why parking was included in front of the building. The applicant said the spaces are limited, mainly for commercial visitors and staff, and that city parking garages are nearby.
Sign lighting hours: A member proposed limiting the sign's lights to one hour before sunrise until no later than 10 p.m., and the board added this as a condition.
